text:
frank_z: I opened a tiny PR to clarify the rate-limits & quota page with a compact migration example and a dashboard snapshot link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4201. Need a quick review on wording and headers.

anya_l: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) show the header name in lowercase (`x-redwood-quota-tenant`) and 2) add a 1-line note that only service tokens can set it.

owen_p: Also add a short snippet demonstrating how to parse rate-limit response headers and implement a minimal backoff. People keep filing tickets without the x-request-id.

frank_z: Added both. Snippet: 

```js
const rem = res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining')
if (Number(rem) <= 0) await backoff() // exponential recommended
// include res.headers.get('x-request-id') when filing support tickets
```

anya_l: Please link to the public Grafana snapshot instead of internal dashboards. We already have a snapshot for a tier cutover: https://grafana.public/redwood/snap/tiers-2026-03. Replaced internal link.

docs-bot: lint: line-length warning on code fence.

frank_z: fixed formatting, wrapped lines. Re-ran CI.

docs-bot: docs PR #4201 passed checks (4/4).

own_p: LGTM. One last doc nit: add FAQ line "Will quotas take effect immediately?" with answer: often yes, but legacy migrations may have short grace windows.

frank_z: added FAQ and merged. Will follow up to create the public snapshot used on the learn page. :tada:
